_doc: PLACEHOLDER — Sérgio voice pass pending, EVERY display string below. R28-2b (docs/REINTERP_R28-2_GUIDED_NARRATIVE_SPEC_2026-07-10.md §3, the tapes): three cassette props on the Room 1 bookcase shelf, played through the boombox (src/narrative/tapes.ts owns the state machine + witness filing; src/engine/app.ts wires the physical click + the room-caption DOM + audio). Segments are `{ id, at, caption, kind, audio }` — `at` is seconds from PLAY start (ambient playback advancing captions on its own clock, NOT a player-facing deadline — no scrubbing/progress UI exists, per the click/tap law); `audio` optionally names a future bundled filename (src/audio/tapeAudio.ts's registry) — an unregistered name is simply never requested (no console error), so real files can drop in later by adding one registry line + the file itself, exactly like src/room/assets.ts's model manifest. WITNESS SYMMETRY (binding, ERA_MINING FIND #4, R28-2 spec §3/§6): Tape A and Tape B file 'playedThrough' (reached the tail after their last segment) or 'stoppedMidway' (play started — elapsedSec > 0 — then stopped/ejected/era-shifted before the tail) to ledger.tapes; a tape that is never pressed to PLAY (inserting it alone does not count) files NOTHING — unplayed media gets no response, same doctrine as the guide thread. Tape C (the mixtape) carries NO `witness` field at all (null) and src/narrative/tapes.ts enforces in CODE, not just by omitting data here, that it never reaches ledger.tapes and never sets the 'tape-played' ledger record the guide's `tape` side-message (s1_guide.json) waits on — playing your own mixtape is not compliance (R28-2 spec §6's ambient-presence law: the system's silence about it IS its meaning). Tape A's prayer segment is intentionally a bracketed stage-direction caption, not sung lyrics — the actual words are G1-gated, Sérgio's alone (spec §3); this file only reserves the beat and its (empty) audio slot. Tape B's ad-style captions are a period '97 AM-radio-spot shift of the already-authored data/dialog/s2_media.json campaign (same invented ministry/brand — 'THE NEW YOU', a ministry of Restorify™ — no real orgs/likenesses/verbatim testimony), grounded per docs/ERA2_EVANGELIST_COMMERCIAL_SCRIPT_2026-06-30.md (1998 'Truth in Love' + televangelist-infomercial grammar) — every campaign-claim caption carries its own [VERIFY SOURCE] below. cutting/beat metadata per the rails.
